title: Determinations and validations
explain: Determinations derive fields; validations enforce invariants. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Determinations and validations" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Determinations and validations, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Determinations and validations without a failure story
howToApply: Use Determinations and validations explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Determinations and validations” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Determinations → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using Determinations and validations without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Determinations and validations” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Determinations and validations”.
